title: Modular presubmit ghostworker and dep-harvester to shrink presubmit latency and stabilize deps
author: Anika Patel
description: Adds a modular presubmit 'ghostworker' process that prefetches toolchains and third-party deps in a separate, low-priority lane and a dep-harvester that snapshots transitive dependency metadata for lightweight presubmit validation. Motivation: reduce noisy presubmit failures from network/timeouts and shrink the main presubmit runtime by decoupling long I/O from lint/test runners. This PR introduces a new presubmit service (ci/ghostworker) with a containerized prefetcher, a dep-harvester binary (tools/dep-harvester) that emits a dep-manifest, and a presubmit router that routes PRs into fast/slow lanes based on a heuristic. Also adds a staged lint holdback to preserve a short fast-path for quick feedback and a migration script to populate initial dep snapshots. Includes docs, unit tests for the harvester, and telemetry for queueing latency.
commits: 3 commits: 1) Add ghostworker service and prefetch container image (ci: add ghostworker, Dockerfile, k8s job spec). 2) Implement dep-harvester binary and manifest schema (tools/dep-harvester, tests). 3) Presubmit router + migration script + docs and telemetry hooks. Each commit annotated with short msgs and signed off by author.
review_comments: Reviewer Marco Alvarez: Please add retries around network fetch in the harvester; observed a transient failure in integration run. Author reply: Added exponential backoff and circuit-breaker, pushed a follow-up commit. Reviewer Leila Rahman: The presubmit-router heuristic needs a clear opt-out for teams that want deterministic runs. Author reply: Added PR label opt-out 'presubmit:force-fast' and a per-repo config in ci/presubmit-config.yaml. Reviewer Tom Brewer: Can we ensure the ghostworker respects quota and avoids prefetching private packages without creds? Author reply: Ghostworker will only prefetch public registries by default and reads per-repo credentials from a sealed secret; documented behavior updated.
